register.labelZh: LOOK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: LOOK 片語動詞可以表示某人望向某物、望向另一邊、低頭、抬頭或把視線移開。；look after、look out for、look to 和 look up to 可以用來談論照顧別人、尋求幫助和敬佩他人。；look for、look up、look through、look over 和 look into 可以描述不同的尋找、查閱、檢查和調查方式。；look back 可以用來回顧過去;look ahead、look to the future 和 look forward to 則可以用來談論未來的計劃和期待。
register.summaryEn: LOOK expressions can show whether someone turns towards something, looks across a space, lowers their eyes, raises their head or turns away. Look after, look out for, look to and look up to help you talk about caring for people, asking for help and admiring others. Look for, look up, look through, look over and look into describe different ways of searching, checking and investigating. Look back helps you discuss past experiences. Look ahead, look to the future and look forward to help you discuss future plans and expectations.
